## Rule

Fill enclosed 0-regions in a 0/3 grid. A 0-cell is exterior iff it is
4-connected to the 20x20 crop boundary through non-wall cells; cells not reached
by that flood fill become color 4. Color 3 walls remain unchanged. Padding cells
inside the static 20x20 crop are traversable, matching the current live model's
boundary-fill behavior.

## Algorithm sketch

Reference: `Task_by_Task/task002/prototypes/task002_numpy_reference.py`.

```python
walls = (input == 3)
reachable = flood_fill_from_20x20_boundary(~walls, connectivity=4)
enclosed = (~walls) & (~reachable)
output = input.copy()
output[enclosed] = 4
```

## FLOOR PROOF — 9413 (bo_ng_cld_worker1, 2026-07-02; supersedes the 9545 proof below)

> **CORRECTION.** The 2026-06-30 "9545 is a true floor / byte-equal-cheaper is impossible" verdict was WRONG — it checked only *function*-changing frontier configs and asserted the exact graph was already minimal without auditing for redundant-valued initializers or removable remask nodes. A **byte-equal safe compression to 9413 (−132)** exists, was Kaggle-confirmed on 2026-06-26 (+0.014 LB, probe OK), and is recaptured/staged here. Floor is now **9413**, not 9545.

**Bar:** team manifest cost 9545, sha12 `0c7d82de886f`, owner Boladi (re-verified live). LIVE = `rayseed_bitpack_5` = `build(iters=5, vshifts=(1,2,4), suffix=(1,2,4), visible_repair=True)`; reproduced byte-for-byte (sha matches).

**The 9413 fold (byte-equal, staged `staged_candidates/task002_enclosedfill_cost9413/`, sha `8c8340bc…`, builder `prototypes/build_dedupe_9413.py` reproduces target SHA exactly):**
- **Memory −80:** drop `reach_0 = (ray_unmasked & open_bits)`; feed `ray_unmasked` straight into flood iter-0. The end-of-iteration `& open_bits` re-masks, so the enclosed output is identical — one uint32 `[1,1,20,1]` @80B tensor eliminated.
- **Params −52:** 7 initializers duplicate an existing one — reuse the survivor: `shift1`→`one_u32` (−1); `top_idx1`→`prev_idx`, `bot_idx1`→`next_idx` (identical int64[20], −40); `bit_masks_mid`→`bit_masks_lo` (identical uint8[1,1,1,8], −8); `repair_row_idx0/1/2`→`pack_steps`/`pack_axes`/`pack_starts` (values [1]/[2]/[0], −3).
- Gates: visible 268/268; `ab --full` 200268/200268 byte_equal=True div=0; profile static=9413 profile=9413 (mem 8962 + par 451). Cost is pure `memory(8962)+params(451)`.

**Scoring fact:** cost = `calculate_memory` (Σ bytes of every node-output/value_info tensor, `max(static,profiled)`; `input`/`output` excluded) + `calculate_params` (Σ initializer **element counts**, not bytes). Post-fold = 8962 mem + 451 par. All shapes static ⇒ static cost = profile cost. Memory anatomy: 90× uint32 `[1,1,20,1]` flood/ray masks @80B = 6592; bool Pad`[1,1,30,30]`=900 + Concat`[1,1,20,20]`=400 + 3-lane unpack bool/u8 ≈ 1020; Conv f32 120 + setup.

**Why no exact-semantics graph beats 9413:** every remaining tensor is load-bearing and every initializer is now a distinct value. (a) 20-row packed mask must be uint32 (**uint16 has no ORT kernel**) at one row per axis-2 element (clean Gather for vert neighbors) ⇒ 80B/flood-tensor forced; (b) each 4-neighbor flood step needs ≥9 tensors (2 BitShift L/R + 2 Gather U/D + 4 binary-OR tree to combine 5 inputs — BitwiseOr is binary, Max≠bitwise-OR so can't fold — + 1 AND-mask) — irreducible; (c) 30×30 bool Where-mask (900B) + 20-wide Concat (400B) + 3-lane unpack (#157) all semantically required. `pack_w` stays `[1,10,1,20]` (slicing ch3 first costs a 900B `[1,1,30,30]` intermediate > the 180 "wasted" params). After the dedup all 36 initializers are value-distinct; the only other remask candidate (end-of-iter `& open_bits`) is load-bearing (it clips wall bits before the next expansion). **⇒ 9413 is the byte-equal floor.** (Verify before trusting: `python prototypes/build_dedupe_9413.py` must print MATCH.)

> **Mechanically verified minimal (2026-07-12, bo_ng_cld_worker1).** Static audit + value-CSE hunt + counterexample tests upgrade "argued load-bearing" to "proven minimal": **0 dup inits / 0 dead nodes / 0 CSE / 0 identity nodes** (structural), **no value-level always-equal ≥80B mask pair** (empirical, 30 inputs), and the one candidate remask `repair_open = repair_bits & open_bits` is **load-bearing** (constructed row1==84218 + wall seed cell (7,15): clip-removed flips a wall to color-4). Also priced-dead: spatial MaxPool morphology (ORT rejects BOOL/INT32; uint8 400–900 B/mask = 5–11× the packed 80 B) and denser uint64 packing (net-negative boundary ops). Full detail + repro scripts: `hard_records/morphologypool_wall.md`.

**Why no cheaper FUNCTION is shippable (gate-failed cost/accuracy frontier, all byte-equal on the 6 train+test-clear officials but verified on full corpus):**
| candidate | cost | Δ | officials (visible 268) | corpus truth (100k) | gate verdict |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| LIVE (i5+4 memo repairs) | 9545 | 0 | 268/268 ✓ | 91.736% | shipped |
| i5 + 4 auto-repair groups | 9542 | −3 | 268/268 ✓ | 91.665% | **FAIL ab** (17 corpus div, lower truth ⇒ §14e artifact) |
| i4 + 5 auto-repair groups | 8951 | −594 | 268/268 ✓ | 89.265% | **FAIL ab** (310 div, much lower truth) |
| pure i5 flood, NO repair | 8852 | −693 | **262/268 ✗** | **91.841%** | **FAIL visible** (§VISIBLE-FAIL: misses 6 arc-gen) |

Frontier is monotone: cost↓ ⇒ flood depth↓ ⇒ correctness↓. Path B (more-correct-AND-cheaper by changing the *function*) is impossible — truth rises monotonically with flood depth (pure i5/i6/i7 = 91.85/93.25/94.05%) and each step costs +720, so any truth>LIVE costs >9545. The only win is the **byte-equal structural shave to 9413** (above) — same function, −132 redundant bytes. **⇒ 9413 is the floor under the visible-100% + ab gate; no function-changing candidate is shippable.**

**NOTABLE (for captain/strategy, NOT a worker ship):** LIVE's 4 memorized repair seeds are **net-negative on broad truth** — pure i5 (no repair) is BOTH cheaper (8852) and more accurate on the 100k corpus (91.841% vs LIVE 91.736%). The repairs exist only to clear 6 arc-gen officials (visible gate); they slightly hurt generalization. If ship policy ever weights corpus/hidden truth over official byte-match, pure-i5 dominates. See `prototypes/task002_i4_5grp_cost8951.onnx`, `task002_i5_4grp_cost9542.onnx` (frontier artifacts) + lesson packet.
